Do you want to help ensure reliable documentation for electrical infrastructure projects? Can you bring structure to complex documentation flows and secure complete project records? And do you have at least five years of experience in document control? Then join COWI as our new Document Controller.

Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

We are looking for a Document Controller to join COWI and support our customer's electrical infrastructure projects. You will help ensure that both internal project documentation and supplier documentation are collected, organised and securely archived. Following an introduction to the relevant processes, methods and systems, you will work with minimal supervision to ensure complete project documentation through to final handover and project closure.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Set up archiving structures in the customer's electronic document and records management system and clarify which documentation must be collected and retained.

• Collect and secure internal project documentation from customer-managed SharePoint sites, as well as photographic documentation and other project records.

• Collect and secure supplier documentation, including collaborating with the customer's IT team on developing APIs or automation tools where needed.

• Ensure that final as-built documentation is complete, that projects comply with the customer's archiving guidelines, and that sites and platforms are closed down at project completion.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways, but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you will have:

• At least five years of experience in document control.

• Experience with electronic document management (EDM) systems, an aptitude for IT and a good working knowledge of Microsoft Office

• Experience managing electronic workflows and as-built documentation.

• Good written and verbal communication skills in both Danish and English.

• A structured and thorough approach, enjoyment of process-oriented tasks, and a service-minded, collaborative and practical attitude. You are motivated and engaged, with a focus on helping projects succeed

Your official COWI office location will be either Lyngby, Vejle or Aarhus. However, your primary workplace will be at Energinet in Erritsø, but Ballerup could also be an option, with some travel to Erritsø. You will report to Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui, who is based at COWI's headquarters in Lyngby.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

From Danish and Swedish handball to Royal Run and Vikingur, you will manage a portfolio of sponsorships, lead commercial negotiations and turn our investments into impactful brand activations. • Lead negotiations: Negotiate commercial terms, rights and budgets with clubs, rights holders, agencies and other partners to secure the right value for Boozt.

• A structured, solution-oriented approach and the flexibility to work around key events and seasonal peaks.

**WHY BOOZT

**At Boozt, you will join a fast-paced and ambitious environment built on trust, freedom and responsibility. You will work across teams, collaborate with well-known sports organisations and bring our sponsorships to life through activations that reach our customers.

We value ownership, collaboration and people who are not afraid to challenge the status quo. If you enjoy negotiating, building relationships and turning sponsorships into meaningful brand experiences, we would love to hear from you.

**Product Management at Dalux – Bringing AI into the Construction Industry

**Dalux continues to grow rapidly, and AI is creating entirely new possibilities for how construction professionals find information, understand complex project data, automate repetitive work, and make decisions.

We're looking for an AI Product Manager to help turn those possibilities into products that create real value for our users.

As an AI Product Manager at Dalux, you'll operate at the intersection of customer needs, rapidly evolving AI technology, and business strategy. You'll work closely with Product Design, AI engineers, developers, and other Product Managers to identify where AI can meaningfully improve construction workflows – and equally importantly, where it cannot.

Building AI products is different from traditional software development. Outputs are probabilistic, quality needs continuous evaluation, and product decisions involve trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost, scalability, and user trust.

You'll help us navigate those trade-offs and establish how we build great AI products at Dalux.

**Your responsibilities will include:

**

• AI Product Discovery: Identify and validate problems where AI can create meaningful value rather than applying AI for its own sake.

• Customer Insights: Work closely with users and internal domain experts to understand construction workflows and identify opportunities for AI-powered improvements.

• Evaluation & Quality: Define what "good" looks like for AI features and establish evals, quality metrics, test cases, and feedback loops.

• AI Safety & Trust: Consider hallucinations, uncertainty, guardrails, failure modes, explainability, and user trust throughout product development.

• Feature Ownership: Lead AI-powered features from early experimentation and prototyping through delivery, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

• Technical Collaboration: Work closely with AI engineers and developers on model capabilities, context, architecture, latency, scalability, and cost.

• AI Product Strategy: Follow developments in models and AI technology and help determine which technological advances create meaningful opportunities for Dalux.

**About You

**We are looking for someone who combines strong product thinking with a solid understanding of modern AI.

You don't need to be an AI engineer, but you need enough technical understanding to make informed product decisions and have meaningful discussions with the engineers building these systems.

We believe you:

• Have experience building or managing customer-facing AI/ML products.

• Understand concepts such as LLMs, RAG, embeddings, context, agents, evals, and guardrails.

• Understand the fundamental difference between building deterministic software and probabilistic AI experiences.

• Can translate rapidly evolving technical capabilities into valuable user experiences.

• Are comfortable defining and measuring quality where traditional acceptance criteria are insufficient.

• Think critically about when AI is – and isn't – the right solution.

• Can balance user value, model quality, latency, scalability, and cost.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Experience with B2B SaaS is an advantage.

Experience with construction technology is welcome but not required. We have deep construction expertise within Dalux – for this role, we are particularly interested in adding strong AI product expertise to our organization.

**What To Expect At Dalux

**At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

**Ready for the next step?

**We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

**About Dalux

**Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

_**About The Role

**OrderYOYO builds the ordering apps and websites that thousands of restaurants across seven European markets use to take orders directly from their own customers. Our Growth team has one number to move: average orders per day per restaurant partner.

We're looking for a Growth Data Analyst to find where those orders are being lost, design the experiments that win them back, and prove it with data — across the end-user apps (iOS and Android), the restaurant partner websites, and the marketing stack.

This is a hands-on role. You'll write the SQL, build the test, read the result, and present it to the people who decide what ships next — working alongside a developer, a marketing manager, a paid media manager, and a data engineer.

**Role Mission

**Grow average orders per day per restaurant partner by finding where orders are lost across apps, websites and marketing channels, running the experiments that win them back, and making the Growth numbers trustworthy enough to decide on.

**Core Responsibilities

**

• Own the end-user funnel view — from visit to order to repeat order — across apps and RP websites, by country and by restaurant partner.

• Run cohort, funnel, and retention analyses to find the biggest leaks in traffic, conversion, and repeat ordering, and size what fixing each one is worth in orders per day.

• Turn findings into a ranked backlog of hypotheses with expected impact and effort, and defend the ranking with the Growth team and Product.

• Design A/B tests end to end — hypothesis, success metric, guardrails, sample size and runtime, randomisation unit, and a pre-registered analysis plan — and set them up yourself on the apps and RP websites, working with the developer on feature flags or variant logic where code changes are needed.

• Check tests while they run (sample ratio, instrumentation, novelty effects) and read them out honestly, including when the result is flat or negative.

• Bring the same discipline to the marketing stack — paid media (Google Ads, Meta), email and push, SMS, landing pages, and restaurant partners' Google Business Profiles — using geo or restaurant-level splits and holdouts where a user-level test isn't possible, and judging traffic quality and incrementality on orders, not clicks.

• Own the definitions of the Growth metrics (AOD, conversion rate, new vs returning, retention), keep them consistent between GA4, the apps, and the warehouse, and chase tracking gaps with the data engineer and developer until fixes are verified with data.

• Partner with Algirdas on the Growth dashboards in Fabric and Power BI so reporting is automated rather than produced by hand.

• Build and own the experimentation playbook, and use AI as a daily tool — for SQL, analysis plans, and readouts — helping the team build small, repeatable AI workflows such as pre-test power calculations or weekly funnel checks. Experimentation is too important to be guesswork.

**Must-Have Requirements

**

• 3 to 5 years in product, growth, or marketing analytics, ideally in a consumer app, marketplace, e-commerce, or food ordering business.

• Strong SQL — able to write and debug multi-step queries over event and transaction data without help.

• A track record of designing, running, and reading A/B tests, with the statistics to do it properly: power and sample size, significance, guardrail metrics, and the common ways a test lies (peeking, sample ratio mismatch, novelty).

• Technical enough to set up a test yourself: comfortable with feature flags or an experimentation tool, basic JavaScript or app event instrumentation, and reading a tracking plan.

• Hands-on with a product or web analytics stack (GA4 or similar) and a BI tool (Power BI, Looker, Tableau, or similar).

• Comfortable testing in marketing channels as well as in product: campaign experiments in Google Ads or Meta, email or push tests, and geo or holdout designs for measuring incrementality.

• Uses AI tools daily for analysis work and can show how it changed the way you work.

• Clear, confident communication — able to take a messy result and explain to a non-technical audience what it means and what to do next, in writing and in person.

• Owns outcomes, not tasks, and is comfortable setting the plan in a small team rather than waiting for one.

• Fluent English. Danish is not required.

**Strong-to-Have Experience

**

• Python or R for statistical analysis and automating recurring checks.

• Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, or another lakehouse and BI setup.

• Mobile app experimentation (Firebase, Optimizely, GrowthBook, Statsig, or similar) and web experimentation on multi-tenant or white-label sites.

• Sequential or Bayesian test methods, or quasi-experiments where a true A/B test isn't possible (for example, market-level or restaurant-level rollouts).

• Paid media data (Google Ads, Meta) and attribution, to judge traffic quality as well as conversion.

• A customer data platform and B2C engagement tooling (Segment, Braze, Firebase messaging, or similar), including running lifecycle tests in them.

• Building AI-assisted workflows or agents for analysis, not only using chat tools.

**Who We Are

**At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. Personal development is central to how we work — engineers are encouraged to grow technically, take responsibility, and help shape how our products and platforms evolve.

We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps, and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business. By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably.

Through our partnership with AppSmart, the market leader in POS and in-store systems, we've become the largest restaurant-focused platform in Europe.

**What We Offer

**

• A salary of DKK59,000/ month

• A hybrid role based in Copenhagen.

• High ownership and autonomy over the analysis and experiments you run.

• The opportunity to directly move a revenue-critical metric: orders per day.

• A strong focus on data quality, honest experimentation, and analytics best practices.

• A collaborative, international Growth team.

• Real emphasis on learning, mentoring, and personal development.

**Bring your engineering expertise to processes that help protect lives every day

**Do you enjoy solving complex manufacturing challenges and turning technical insight into lasting improvements?

At Bavarian Nordic, we are looking for a Engineering Specialist to strengthen our Drug Substance manufacturing processes and support the introduction of new equipment and technologies.

You will join Material & Sterile Operation, reporting to the Senior Manager, and combine hands-on problem-solving with technical leadership. Your work will help ensure that our processes deliver reliable performance, consistent quality, and GMP compliance.

**Your impact

**As a technical expert for your assigned process areas, you will help develop, optimize, validate, and maintain manufacturing processes throughout their lifecycle. You will challenge existing solutions, identify risks before they affect production, and turn improvement opportunities into practical results.

Working across Manufacturing, Engineering, Automation, and Quality, you will also share your expertise and strengthen process understanding across teams.

**What You Will Do

**

• Improve process performance: Lead process design and optimization, address bottlenecks and operational risks, and troubleshoot complex manufacturing challenges to improve efficiency, reliability, and quality.

• Provide expertise in CIP/SIP: Act as a Subject Matter Expert for Cleaning-in-Place and Sterilization-in-Place systems, improving system design, component selection, and cleaning and sterilization strategies.

• Introduce equipment and technologies: Guide technical activities from specifications and vendor design reviews through factory and site acceptance testing, commissioning, qualification, and validation.

• Support validation and technology transfer: Develop validation strategies, lead and support Process Performance Qualification (PPQ), and drive the transfer of processes into manufacturing or between sites.

• Strengthen compliance: Lead and support deviations, root cause investigations, CAPAs, change controls, and risk assessments. Represent your technical areas during audits and inspections.

• Develop technical capability: Coach colleagues, provide training, and share engineering knowledge to strengthen process understanding and consistent execution.

**What You Bring

**You hold a master’s degree in Chemical, Bioprocess, Process, or Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline, and have at least 10 years of industrial process engineering experience.

You bring:

• A strong track record in process design, optimization, and structured troubleshooting within GMP manufacturing. Experience in pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, vaccines, or another highly regulated industry is strongly preferred.

• Extensive hands-on expertise in CIP/SIP design, operation, and optimization.

• In-depth knowledge of process equipment, piping, valves, and instrumentation, together with an understanding of how process and automation systems interact.

• Experience with equipment introduction, qualification, validation, PPQ, and technology transfer, including changes requiring regulatory approval.

• Solid knowledge of pharmaceutical quality systems and regulatory expectations, with practical experience in investigations, CAPAs, change controls, risk assessments, and inspection support.

**How You Work

**You combine analytical thinking with practical judgement and take ownership of moving issues towards resolution.

You are comfortable questioning established practices and can explain why a proposed change will improve process performance or reduce risk.

You communicate complex technical topics clearly, build constructive relationships across functions, and balance attention to detail with an understanding of production needs and business priorities. You also enjoy helping others develop through coaching, knowledge sharing, and collaboration.

**An opportunity to grow your leadership

**This role offers the opportunity to make an immediate impact through technical leadership. For the right candidate, it may also provide a pathway into formal people management, potentially leading a team of approximately 8–10 Process Engineers.

Progression will depend on demonstrated performance, sound judgement, and the ability to develop others, build an inclusive team environment, and translate business priorities into practical execution.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic?

**At Bavarian Nordic, we work to protect lives through vaccines. Your engineering expertise will contribute directly to the manufacturing processes that make this possible.

You will have opportunities to influence technical solutions, support important technology transfers, and see your improvements become part of daily operations. Guided by our values—Persisting Pioneers, Embracing Change, and Boosted by the Team—we work together to solve challenges and strengthen our capabilities

**Ready to make a difference? Apply now!

**Apply by clicking the ‘APPLY’ button. We are interviewing on an ongoing basis and look forward to receiving your CV.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

**For us, it is all about improving and saving lives

**Improving and saving lives through innovative vaccines is at the heart of what we do at Bavarian Nordic. We are a fully integrated vaccine company focused on the development, manufacturing and commercialisation of life-saving vaccines, and the largest pure-play vaccine company in the world.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

Do you have solid experience with registry-based research from a public authority, a consultancy or academia, and are you ready to take ownership of studies from first idea to final delivery?

Then you might be exactly who we are looking for.

NHTA is a boutique healthcare consultancy. We focus on quality, creating value for our clients across both the public and private sectors, and delivering practical solutions with a "No BS" approach to consulting. This philosophy has been a key part of our success and continues to shape everything we do.

Our Real-World Evidence team designs and delivers registry-based studies for life-science industry including public and private clients across therapy areas such as oncology, diabetes and obesity, cardiovascular, respiratory and infectious diseases. We work with Danish national registers and increasingly across the Nordic countries.

Your responsibilities

Are You Our Next Rescue Zookeeper at Odsherred Zoo Rescue?

We are looking for two qualified zookeepers with a passion for exotic animals and animal rescue!Fonden Odsherred Zoo Rescue is Denmark's first and only approved rescue centre for exotic animals in need. We provide a permanent home for animals that have experienced difficult circumstances and need specialised care.

We are currently looking for two dedicated, qualified zookeepers to join our team.

About the PositionsThe positions primarily involve caring for our larger animals and a variety of other species, including small wild cats, camels, meerkats, llamas, deer, birds and more.

Our rescue centre is home to approximately 600 animals, representing a wide range of exotic species.

You will work closely with our existing team of six zookeepers and a maintenance colleague. Teamwork is an essential part of our daily operations, and we expect everyone to contribute to a supportive and responsible working environment.

Both positions are full-time and include weekend duties approximately twice a month.

We are looking to fill:

• 
One longer-term position, potentially permanent or lasting 1–2 years.

• 
One shorter-term position, lasting approximately 6–12 months.

We would like the successful candidates to start as soon as possible.

What We Expect From You

We are looking for colleagues who are genuinely passionate about animal welfare and understand the responsibility that comes with working at a rescue centre.

You should be:

• 
A qualified zookeeper with experience or a strong interest in exotic animals.

• 
Reliable, punctual, honest and hardworking.

• 
Positive, adaptable and willing to take responsibility.

• 
A team player who actively supports and communicates with colleagues.

• 
Observant and attentive to the animals in your care, recognising changes in their health, behaviour and general well-being.

• 
Willing to learn and adapt to the different challenges of working with rescued animals.

• 
Comfortable with the practical and sometimes physically demanding nature of animal care.

Teamwork is particularly important to us. We have a working culture in which colleagues help one another complete the day's responsibilities. We expect everyone to contribute, communicate openly and take their responsibilities seriously.

Working at a rescue centre is more than a traditional zookeeping job. It requires dedication, flexibility and an understanding that the needs of rescued animals can be very different from those of animals in conventional zoological collections.

Visitor Presentations and Social Media For approximately half the year, our rescue centre is open to the public.

During this period, all zookeepers participate in educational presentations for visitors, introducing the animals they care for and explaining their stories, behaviour and needs.

Public speaking is a mandatory part of the position, but previous presentation experience is not required as long as you are willing to learn.

We also regularly produce content for our social media platforms to raise awareness of our rescue work and the animals in our care.

This includes livestreams, photographs and recorded videos. Our zookeepers participate in this work by helping communicate the stories of the animals and the daily life of our rescue centre.

Understanding Our Mission, Odsherred Zoo Rescue is built around three main areas of work:

1. Rescue and Rehabilitation — Our Primary Mission

First and foremost, we are a rescue centre for exotic animals in need.

Our animals come from a variety of backgrounds, including the pharmaceutical and cosmetics industries, confiscations, former private ownership and other zoological institutions across Denmark and Europe.

Many of these animals have experienced difficult circumstances and require specialised care, patience and understanding.

Providing them with a safe and permanent home is our highest priority.

2. Conservation and Breeding Programmes

When resources and funding allow, we participate in conservation breeding programmes for rare and endangered species, including tamarins from South America.

Although this is an important part of our work, it remains secondary to our primary rescue mission.

3. Providing Homes for Surplus Zoo Animals

When we have the necessary space and resources, we also welcome surplus animals from other zoological institutions, providing them with a home when they might otherwise face euthanasia.

A Different Approach to Zookeeping, We want to emphasise that working at Odsherred Zoo Rescue is not the same as working at a traditional zoo.

We welcome applicants with experience from conventional zoological institutions, but it is essential that you are open-minded and willing to understand the different principles and challenges involved in operating a rescue centre.

Our focus is not simply on maintaining a zoological collection. It is on providing individual animals with the care, security and permanent home they deserve.

We are looking for colleagues who genuinely share these values and are willing to learn, adapt and contribute to our mission.

How to Apply, If you are passionate about exotic animals, dedicated to animal welfare and would like to become part of our rescue team, we would love to hear from you.

Please send your written application and CV to: post@odsherreds-zoo.dk only written inquiries.

Yours sincerely

Joan Thygesen

Director and founder of

Found Odsherred Zoo Rescue

**Global Application Excellence Manager – Chocolate & Confectionery

**Our story goes back more than 150 years, to the chilly southern coast of Scandinavia. From our early success in Sweden and Denmark, we’ve grown into the world’s leading specialist producer of plant-based oils, employing more than 4,000 people across the globe.

We work with our customers to make the products you love even better. The oils we produce go into making your chocolate extra-creamy or putting the crunch into your croissant. And it’s not just food — we work across industries to make products that are higher quality, healthier and better for the planet.

Everything we do is about **Making Better Happen™.

****AAK Location

**This role will be based at our site in Aarhus.

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Global Application Excellence Manager to join AAK’s Applied Innovation organisation and serve as one of our global technical authorities within Chocolate & Confectionery Fats (CCF). Combining deep expertise in confectionery formulation, fat functionality and processing with innovation and industry knowledge, you will help strengthen AAK’s position as The Co-Development Company.

In this role, you will expand and strengthen AAK’s application knowledge by developing and validating customer-relevant proof points, leading lower-complexity product development projects and supporting Scientists on medium- and long-term innovation programmes. You will translate technical expertise into practical customer solutions that demonstrate the value of AAK’s portfolio.

Working alongside our other Global Application Excellence Manager – Chocolate & Confectionery, you will connect regional application experts, Customer Innovation teams, global functions and external industry stakeholders. You will help ensure knowledge and expertise are shared across regions, while identifying customer needs and market opportunities that can be translated into differentiated solutions and future innovation.

As a global technical reference point, you will support regional teams through technical guidance, training, customer projects and troubleshooting. You will also contribute to the development of AAK’s Confectionery Centre of Excellence and Customer Innovation Network, helping build capabilities and consistent application expertise across the organisation.

**Responsibilities

**

• Act as a global subject matter expert in Chocolate & Confectionery applications, with deep knowledge of CCF formulation, fat functionality, processing technologies and ingredient interactions.

• Connect regional application experts, Customer Innovation teams and global technical functions to strengthen knowledge sharing and ensure expertise is effectively leveraged across AAK.

• Design, develop and validate compelling application proof points that demonstrate customer value and differentiate AAK’s solutions.

• Lead lower-complexity product development projects while supporting Scientists on more complex, medium- and long-term innovation programmes.

• Translate new products and technologies into customer demonstrations, application evidence, technical documentation and materials that support successful commercialisation.

• Support regional teams with complex application and processing challenges through troubleshooting, technical guidance, customer workshops, factory trials and evaluations.

• Strengthen the Confectionery Centre of Excellence by developing application methods, evaluation protocols, best practices, technical tools and knowledge resources.

• Deliver AAK Academy training and technical learning programmes while supporting the development of the CCF Customer Innovation Network and wider technical capabilities.

• Analyse customer innovation projects and market developments to identify recurring needs, application gaps, future proof points and opportunities for new product development.

• Represent AAK within the wider confectionery ecosystem through relationships with suppliers, equipment manufacturers and industry experts, while supporting technology scouting and competitive benchmarking.

• Contribute to intellectual property activities, including technical evidence, application validation and competitive differentiation where relevant.

**About You

**

• MSc or PhD in Food Science, Food Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline.

• 8–10+ years of relevant industry experience within chocolate, confectionery, specialty fats or related food applications.

• Recognised expertise in Chocolate & Confectionery Fats, including formulation, fat functionality, ingredient interactions and processing technologies across applications such as chocolate, compounds, fillings, spreads and caramel.

• Proven experience in application development, product development, scale-up, customer trials and commercialisation.

• Ability to translate customer needs, market trends and technical knowledge into differentiated application solutions and compelling customer value.

• Experience working across global, cross-functional organisations, connecting technical experts and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

• Strong troubleshooting, process optimisation and communication skills, with a passion for knowledge sharing, capability building and mentoring.

• Experience with innovation processes, technology scouting, competitive benchmarking or intellectual property activities is an advantage; fluent in English and willing to travel internationally.

**In return AAK offers

**

• Join a pioneering company in specialty oils and fats, driving innovation and sustainability.

• In AAK you can work across 25+ countries, gaining international exposure and collaborating with a diverse team.

• AAK invests in your development with training, mentorship, and clear career paths.

• You will contribute to a greener world with AAK's sustainability-focused approach.

• Join a diverse and inclusive workplace that values every individual's perspective and talents.

**Contact and information

**For further information about the position, please contact Emily Lumb, Talent Acquisition Specialist: emily.lumb@aak.com

**About AAK

**Everything AAK does is about Making Better Happen™. We specialise in plant-based oils that are the value-adding ingredients in many of the products people love to consume. We make these products better tasting, healthier, and more sustainable.

At the heart of AAK’s offer is Customer Co-Development, combining our desire to understand what better means for each customer with the flexibility of our production assets and deep knowledge across multiple industries, including Chocolate and Confectionery, Bakery, Dairy, Plant-based Foods, Special Nutrition, Foodservice and Personal Care.

Our 4,000 employees support close collaboration with customers through 25 regional sales offices, 15 dedicated Customer Innovation Centers, and more than 20 production facilities worldwide. Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, AAK has been Making Better Happen™ for more than 150 years.

AAK is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued and everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow.

Director - AI & Data Advisory

The role:

NNIT is strengthening its Advisory & AI capability to help life sciences clients turn AI and data ambition into

measurable business outcomes. We are looking for a Director to lead the AI & Data Advisory team, combining

management consulting leadership, commercial accountability, people management and a strong understanding

of AI and data in regulated environments.

The Director will be accountable for building a high-performing, market-facing team that opens senior client

conversations, originates and converts opportunities, delivers high-quality management consulting

engagements and develops relevant offerings based on market demand. The role sits in AI & Data Advisory

under Advisory & AI and works across R&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and cross-functional regulated

capabilities and connects client needs to NNIT domain and technology specialists, including the AI Factory in

the Philippines.

This is not a technology delivery leadership role. The Director must understand AI, data and the associated

regulatory considerations in depth to advise senior stakeholders, shape compelling propositions, and mobilize

the right specialists. The primary mandate is to grow and lead a commercially successful management

consulting team.

Your responsibilities as Director - AI & Data Advisory:

Lead and develop the AI & Data Advisory team: Set clear direction and priorities for the team and hold

responsibility for performance, development, engagement, staffing and capacity. Lead the team through regular

one-to-ones, performance and development conversations, coaching and clear follow-up. Build a culture of

commercial ownership, collaboration and high-quality consulting.

Drive commercial growth: Own the commercial performance of the area and work closely with Sales, account

teams and the Life Sciences business areas to build qualified pipeline, originate opportunities and convert them

into bookings and revenue. Maintain visibility of pipeline, utilization, delivery outlook and capability needs, and

intervene early where progress is off track.

Build trusted executive client relationships: Develop and maintain relationships with senior stakeholders

across life sciences. Lead strategic client conversations, frame business challenges, build executive alignment

and position NNIT as a trusted management consulting partner for AI- and data-enabled transformation.

Oversee high-impact management consulting engagements: Ensure that engagements are well shaped,

commercially sound and delivered to a high standard. Provide senior oversight on complex assignments

covering AI strategy and governance, AI readiness, data and analytics strategy, AI-enabled quality and

continuous improvement, transformation programs, and AI-enabled operating models.

Develop and commercialize the offering portfolio: Own the direction and commercial relevance of the AI &

Data Advisory portfolio. Ensure that existing offerings are positioned and delivered consistently, using the AI

Value Compass as one example. Convert recurring client needs, market developments and delivery experience

into new or improved offerings, methods, executive workshop formats, commercial narratives, pricing logic and

reusable assets.

Connect advisory to implementation and scale: Ensure that advisory engagements create credible pathways

into transformation, implementation, validation and managed services where relevant. Maintain clear ownership across advisory, Life Sciences domains and technology delivery, while avoiding the creation of a separate

technology silo.

Bridge to the AI Factory and wider NNIT capabilities: Act as the senior commercial and consulting link

between client demand, NNIT business areas and the AI Factory in the Philippines. Ensure opportunities are

properly qualified and shaped before technical mobilization, with clear scope, value case, governance and

accountabilities.

Shape proposals and commercial models: Lead or quality-assure major proposals, RfPs, Statements of

Work and commercial cases. Ensure that scope, pricing, delivery model, responsibilities, risk and expected

client outcomes are explicit and support healthy growth.

Strengthen market position: Represent NNIT in relevant client forums, industry events and selected thoughtleadership activities. Build external credibility around management consulting, responsible AI, data strategy and

regulated execution, grounded in tangible client outcomes.

Collaborate across the operating model: Work across Advisory & AI, R&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain,

Sales and shared capabilities to bring the best of NNIT to each client. Reinforce common priorities, clear

ownership and integrated account development rather than creating parallel structures.

What the team will work on:

The team’s management consulting engagements may include:

• AI strategy, governance and readiness assessments for regulated life sciences organisations

• Data and analytics strategy, data readiness and trusted data foundations for AI

• AI-enabled Quality, risk, knowledge management and continuous improvement

• AI transformation programs, adoption and value-realisation roadmaps

• Agentic workflows and AI-enabled operating model design with appropriate human oversight and

governance

• AI and data discovery and value-assessment engagements, including the AI Value Compass where relevant

• Client-specific AI and data propositions shaped with NNIT domain specialists and delivered with appropriate

technology capabilities, including the AI Factory

Your qualifications and experience:

• 12+ years of relevant management consulting experience, preferably from a recognized strategy,

management or technology consulting firm, with a strong record in life sciences or other regulated

industries.

• Proven experience leading and developing a consulting team, including performance management,

capability development, staffing, recruitment and creating clear accountability.

• Strong commercial track record with accountability for pipeline, opportunity origination, bookings, revenue

and account growth.

• Demonstrated ability to build C-level relationships, open new client conversations and convert strategic

dialogue into material consulting and transformation engagements.

• Proven management consulting toolkit, including hypothesis-led problem solving, executive facilitation,

transformation and operating model design, quantitative value-case development and board-level

storytelling.

• Sufficient understanding of AI strategy, responsible AI and governance, data strategy, analytics, GenAI and

agentic approaches to advise executives, challenge assumptions and work credibly with specialists. Deep

hands-on engineering or architecture expertise is not required.

• Life sciences experience strongly preferred, including an understanding of regulated environments and the

implications of GxP, quality, validation, privacy and data governance for AI-enabled solutions.

• Experience developing, productizing and commercializing consulting offerings based on client demand and

market insight.

• Ability to mobilize multidisciplinary and distributed teams across management consulting, life sciences

domains, architecture, data/AI and global delivery.

• Strong communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills. Fluency in English is essential.

Fluency in German would be preferred.

What success looks like:

• The team has clear priorities, strong engagement and visible individual accountability, with development and

performance actively managed.

• The area builds a healthy, qualified pipeline and converts it into profitable consulting revenue and broader

NNIT opportunities.

• Clients recognize NNIT as a trusted management consulting partner able to connect AI and data ambition

with measurable business outcomes in regulated environments.

• The offering portfolio remains commercially relevant and evolves based on recurring client needs, market

insight and evidence from delivery.

• Advisory engagements lead to credible roadmaps and, where appropriate, downstream transformation,

implementation, validation and managed-service opportunities.

• The AI Factory and other delivery capabilities are connected to well-shaped demand with clear scope, value

cases and ownership.

• The team collaborates effectively across the operating model and strengthens strategic client relationships

without creating a separate silo.

Why join Advisory & AI:

This role offers the opportunity to build and lead a management consulting team at the front of NNIT’s client

agenda. You will shape senior client conversations, drive commercial growth, develop people and ensure that

NNIT’s AI and data propositions remain relevant, differentiated and connected to tangible execution across the

Life Sciences portfolio.

About NNIT:

NNIT provides consulting and IT services to life sciences and other regulated organisations. We combine deep

domain expertise, advisory, technology and global delivery to create tangible customer impact. In this role, that

means leading a team that brings AI and data into real regulated business contexts and ensures that executive

ambition is translated into commercial opportunities and scalable client outcomes.
